Preserve AGPL-3.0-only, document usage and limitations, and attach actual release evidence.
Respect repository permissions and explicit requirements for shared-history/tag actions; record any blocker rather than inventing success.

steps.action: Inspect accepted qualification evidence, actual reviewed commits and public repository status.
steps.expected_result: Release prerequisites and blockers are explicit before publication claims.

steps.action: Prepare alpha version/changelog, demo commands and AGPL-3.0-only notices for the reviewed scope.
steps.expected_result: Reviewable release material accurately describes functionality, limitations and source provenance.

steps.action: Publish only through authorized repository actions and attach real public commit/CI/release links.
steps.expected_result: The public luofang34/dpm evidence identifies the intended source; blocked steps remain reported as blocked.

in_scope: Scoped public alpha preparation and authorized publication evidence.
out_of_scope: Change the license, make the target repository private, force shared history or create tags without required authorization.
verification: Check public repository visibility and resolve every linked artifact to the intended reviewed commit.
Re-run documented demo commands and applicable quality gates before publication.

973bf299-2998-54fa-a1dc-a58d2f66eff8.title: Specify operation/revision exchange
973bf299-2998-54fa-a1dc-a58d2f66eff8.objective: Define a minimal local/network sync boundary over semantic operations, with no CRDT bypass of domain invariants.

acceptance.text: Specify revision preconditions, identities, deduplication, conflict outcomes and validation order.
Describe LocalOnly behavior and an exchange contract suitable for a later server.
Test protocol examples without introducing a SaaS dependency.

steps.action: Specify semantic operation envelopes, base revisions, actor attribution and deduplication keys.
steps.expected_result: Protocol examples define accepted, duplicate, stale and invalid operation outcomes.

steps.action: Implement the reviewed local backend boundary and validation/conflict interfaces.
steps.expected_result: LocalOnly behavior exercises the same invariants expected from a later network adapter.

steps.action: Test exchange examples and document ordering, retry and failure semantics.
steps.expected_result: A server implementer can follow the contract without inferring raw Git or CRDT synchronization rules.

in_scope: Minimal operation/revision exchange contract and LocalOnly boundary.
out_of_scope: SaaS dependencies, full collaboration transport or CRDT writes bypassing domain validation.
verification: Test accepted/duplicate/stale/invalid exchange examples and deterministic conflict responses.
Run ./ci.sh and compare resulting operations to engine validation outcomes.

0752410b-cd82-5af0-b289-e88a6138c82e.title: Separate principals from credentials
0752410b-cd82-5af0-b289-e88a6138c82e.objective: Prepare the server identity boundary for humans, agents and services with local/device/service credentials and future passkey/OIDC/Apple adapters.

acceptance.text: Keep vendor credentials separate from actor/domain identity.
Specify authorization of workspace operations and independent verification policy.
Test local credential rejection and principal attribution without building an account product.

steps.action: Separate actor/principal identity from credential providers and document workspace authorization rules.
steps.expected_result: The contract accommodates human, agent and service actors without vendor-specific user identity.

steps.action: Implement the approved local/device/service credential boundary for the optional server.
steps.expected_result: Valid credentials attribute commands to the intended principal and invalid credentials fail closed.

steps.action: Test authorization and independent-verifier policy and document future provider extension points.
steps.expected_result: Passkey/OIDC/Apple remain adapters to a stable principal model, not implemented account products.

in_scope: Principal/credential abstraction and minimum approved server credential checks.
out_of_scope: Full account registration, production passkey/OIDC/Apple enrollment or identity derived from untrusted actor strings.
verification: Test absent/invalid credentials, wrong workspace permission and attributable accepted operations.
Check self-verification rejection under principal mapping; run ./ci.sh.

7b02eb97-e80f-56ee-a52c-33f492517ffa.title: Implement an approved minimal sync server
7b02eb97-e80f-56ee-a52c-33f492517ffa.objective: Implement the smallest approved HTTP query/operation adapter, reusing engine/store logic and the reviewed identity boundary.

acceptance.text: Support authenticated query and operation exchange with revision checks and typed conflict responses.
Demonstrate atomic validated persistence and clean shutdown on disposable storage.
Keep the storage/transport boundary explicit and avoid unimplemented collaboration promises.

steps.action: Read accepted SYNC-10/AUTH-10 contracts and define the smallest query/operation HTTP surface.
steps.expected_result: Each endpoint maps to an existing engine/service operation with explicit auth and revision errors.

steps.action: Implement the approved transport adapter and atomic persistence using shared services.
steps.expected_result: Authenticated operations preserve the same domain validation and revision outcomes as local clients.

steps.action: Run disposable-storage request/restart/shutdown tests and publish the working API contract.
steps.expected_result: Evidence demonstrates clean shutdown, typed conflicts and no partially persisted operations.

in_scope: Approved minimal authenticated HTTP query and operation exchange server.
out_of_scope: Full SaaS product, richer collaboration promises, business logic duplicated in handlers or platform UI.
verification: Use ephemeral 127.0.0.1:0 listeners to test valid/invalid auth, stale operations and restart persistence.
Exercise graceful shutdown and atomic failure; run ./ci.sh and shared adapter checks.

9d92e316-9dd6-5d1c-8b2e-d876cb24aa1c.title: Verify multi-client collaboration invariants
9d92e316-9dd6-5d1c-8b2e-d876cb24aa1c.objective: Independently test the optional server with competing agents before considering richer collaboration.

acceptance.text: Exercise simultaneous/stale operations, duplicates, authorization failures and invalid graph changes.
Verify no operation is silently lost or accepted without its domain/revision checks.
Attach reproducible integration evidence and document transport limitations.

steps.action: Build independent clients against the optional server with controlled revisions and credentials.
steps.expected_result: The test harness coordinates concurrent events without fixed ports or sleep-based races.

steps.action: Exercise competing writes, retries/duplicates, stale revisions and invalid/unauthorized operations.
steps.expected_result: Every operation is accepted once or returns an explicit reproducible conflict/rejection.

steps.action: Inspect final state/history and attach integration evidence with remaining transport limitations.
steps.expected_result: No successful operation is silently lost and authoritative invariants survive concurrency.

in_scope: Independent multi-client correctness tests for the approved server.
out_of_scope: Build rich comments/presence, new transports or bypass checks to simplify concurrent tests.
verification: Use event synchronization and ephemeral ports; verify revision continuity and operation deduplication.
Test restarts and rejected invalid changes leave state intact; run ./ci.sh.

46190a5d-e9f7-5102-be21-40f587988e97.title: Specify native/Web projection contracts
46190a5d-e9f7-5102-be21-40f587988e97.objective: Design stable query/view-model contracts suitable for SwiftUI, Web and Compose; do not build all platform products in this task.

acceptance.text: Map Today/Work/Network/Detail to existing query/command semantics and identity boundaries.
Document platform-specific UI freedom and optional Rust FFI boundaries.
Require separate implementation scope before selecting or building a production UI stack.

steps.action: Map Today/Work/Network/Detail user needs to current queries, commands and principal boundaries.
steps.expected_result: A platform-neutral field/interaction matrix identifies reusable data and unsupported requests.

steps.action: Specify versioned view models and optional Rust FFI/HTTP boundaries with error and revision handling.
steps.expected_result: SwiftUI/Web/Compose clients can interpret the same contracts without owning business rules.

steps.action: Review sample payloads and document native UI freedom and separate implementation decisions.
steps.expected_result: A reviewable API design exists without committing to or claiming a platform product.

in_scope: Native/Web projection contract design and sample payload review.
out_of_scope: Build multiple platform apps, select a production framework without scope approval or move authoritative state into UI.
verification: Compare sample payloads to engine queries and command/revision errors.
Walk through selection, detail, blocked work and independent-review scenarios using the proposed fields.

efdabaef-268c-5e7c-888b-0fee76b7df90.title: Bound rich text and CloudKit collaboration designs
efdabaef-268c-5e7c-888b-0fee76b7df90.objective: Document optional comments/presence/CRDT and CloudKit integration points while preserving strongly validated execution state.

acceptance.text: Separate text/presence data from lifecycle, gates, dependencies and permissions.
Document offline/revision conflicts and native-platform constraints without claiming a transport implementation.
List resource/cost/portfolio/procurement extensions as future scope, not giant speculative enums.

steps.action: Identify which comments/presence data may merge independently and which execution fields require validation.
steps.expected_result: A boundary table excludes lifecycle, gates, dependencies and permissions from unrestricted CRDT updates.

steps.action: Describe offline operation exchange and CloudKit/native adapter constraints using the reviewed revision protocol.
steps.expected_result: Conflict examples preserve domain checks and distinguish optional transport from local authority.

steps.action: Document deferred resource/cost/portfolio/procurement extension points and separate implementation milestones.
steps.expected_result: A bounded design records non-goals without adding speculative domain enums or unfinished services.

in_scope: Design boundaries for optional rich text/presence and CloudKit integration.
out_of_scope: Implement CRDT/CloudKit transport, relax execution invariants or expand into full enterprise portfolio/resource management.
verification: Review offline/conflict examples against semantic operation and authorization contracts.
Check that each proposed field has a clear owner and no text merge can change validated execution state.

6138f172-2971-5cd1-8515-520f6b61be0a.title: Explainable work selection
6138f172-2971-5cd1-8515-520f6b61be0a.statement: An agent discovers eligible leaf tasks from next with reproducible ranking, capability constraints and explicit gates.

50625c7b-d065-5188-a522-bb9fb78eb203.title: Executable task context
50625c7b-d065-5188-a522-bb9fb78eb203.statement: An agent reads objectives, observable acceptance, requirements, dependencies, risks and source context from explain without guessing references.

56af87d0-71ea-5575-bc04-f070a8e9191e.title: Immutable development evidence
56af87d0-71ea-5575-bc04-f070a8e9191e.statement: A real implementation commit and its relevant test/review evidence can be attached to the matching task; an uncommitted working tree is not represented as a finished commit.

4d0b0655-1b34-5b15-b7c7-eb4748c998f7.title: Independent acceptance
4d0b0655-1b34-5b15-b7c7-eb4748c998f7.statement: Submission is distinct from verification; only a different authorized reviewer can accept a result and unlock its downstream tasks.

bf2a0e85-cd71-5fff-87ad-f66a8591a269.title: Terminal projection
bf2a0e85-cd71-5fff-87ad-f66a8591a269.statement: The operator can inspect task hierarchy, remaining Gantt hours, milestones, dependency types and progress, and navigate without modifying the execution graph.

087248db-f9e4-5c27-968d-c2b539178037.title: Graph and persistence correctness
087248db-f9e4-5c27-968d-c2b539178037.statement: Commands preserve validation, stable IDs, revision checks and atomic operation/snapshot persistence; UI and agent adapters own no domain rules.

f334b834-595d-5136-af46-0b308c643c81.title: Safe plan evolution
f334b834-595d-5136-af46-0b308c643c81.statement: Versioned semantic proposals, history/diff and append-only revert enable roadmap changes without database replacement or raw Git merges.

e1682222-b5c1-5fef-9ccd-81d9e40abde8.title: Honest scheduling
e1682222-b5c1-5fef-9ccd-81d9e40abde8.statement: Temporal constraints, calendars and uncertainty remain explicit inputs; CPM, Monte Carlo and percent-complete projections never become authoritative schedule state.

430279b8-809d-5dbf-9795-4b698c09aa6e.title: Validated collaboration
430279b8-809d-5dbf-9795-4b698c09aa6e.statement: Any later network or credential adapter authenticates principals, checks revisions and routes operations through domain validation.

bd186e65-ccd7-5720-abd2-1c75c67da7f6.title: Explicit stage authorization
bd186e65-ccd7-5720-abd2-1c75c67da7f6.statement: This seed is planning only. Broad roadmap entries, provisional estimates and existing source references are not execution authorization, completed work or release evidence.

2e7768c2-5844-53f4-9e45-3387c2eb79e5.label: Local MVP capability and validation report; not independent acceptance

873be17d-6408-5485-8230-5972d5698e89.label: Existing CLI/MCP commands and structured query contract

fcdcae00-adad-5569-b4fb-926602835c87.label: Prepared-only self-host scope and milestone guide

c49ffca1-1b01-5e2b-9954-18971c07312e.question: When has the user explicitly authorized starting the self-host tasks? This prepared seed must remain query-only until that separate instruction.

a7fb9363-39af-5e46-a1a1-2b05baa9fff4.question: Which real source commit, local database and independent reviewer are approved for live self-hosting and publication evidence? The current MVP is not yet a committed/released baseline.

a62796ee-1095-5fea-b048-0335309c39b5.question: Which later terminal layout scope is explicitly accepted after the MVP review? No layout work is authorized by this seed.

f1751454-e429-554c-add8-96aca3db1998.question: Which roadmap phases beyond TUI MVP and agent-understandable/operable work are approved? Core expansion, server/sync/auth/native UI remain deferred.

6ef69bbe-d99a-52fb-a141-c459bd0c3e8e.description: A broad reference roadmap may be mistaken for permission to implement deferred features.
6ef69bbe-d99a-52fb-a141-c459bd0c3e8e.mitigation: Keep DEC-EXECUTE and phase gates open; do not interpret planning data or estimates as authorization.

b683bb26-0d39-52e9-a283-6b2c93dcc082.description: Uncommitted MVP source or local check reports may be misrepresented as independently verified/public release evidence.
b683bb26-0d39-52e9-a283-6b2c93dcc082.mitigation: Distinguish contextual source artifacts from acceptance evidence; establish a real commit and independent review.

cf654136-d86c-5ad9-99e2-2dd5b817fe88.description: The MVP cannot yet apply semantic task/dependency edits in place or expose full history/revert.
cf654136-d86c-5ad9-99e2-2dd5b817fe88.mitigation: Keep this seed reviewable. Do not overwrite live SQLite; use separately approved validated copies for bootstrap authoring until CORE-20/30 are accepted.

56dcce46-6933-5a78-ab22-618ae1133687.description: Provisional O/M/P values and elapsed-hour projections may be mistaken for calendar commitments or resource-leveled dates.
56dcce46-6933-5a78-ab22-618ae1133687.mitigation: Re-estimate before execution; show units and uncertainty. No capacity, calendar or delivery promise is implied.

ad10cfce-3f4f-5646-8cd5-c1c1369eb84f.description: Local actor names can be impersonated and do not provide authenticated independent review.
ad10cfce-3f4f-5646-8cd5-c1c1369eb84f.mitigation: Use trusted separate reviewer processes now; add explicit credential/authorization boundaries only in the approved later scope.
